description: The full Swissmedic record(s) for one product by name — every authorised dosage strength, its own authorisation number and dates. Swissmedic's export carries no indication text and no per-product URL, so this returns the authoritative Swissmedic download instead of a paraphrased indication.

name.description: Exact or near-exact product name, e.g. "Vivotif, Kapseln", as it appears in the Swissmedic export.
